description: Gaussian widths for smearing the transverse (d0) and longitudinal (dz) impact parameters of charged particles, per bin of track pT and |eta|, for the CMS Phase-2 tracker.
source: Derived from CMS Collaboration, The Phase-2 Upgrade of the CMS Tracker, Technical Design Report, CERN-LHCC-2017-009, CMS-TDR-014 (2017), Fig. 12.12: resolution of d0 and dz (RMS of the residuals) against eta for single isolated muons with pT = 1, 10 and 100 GeV. The points were read from the figure's vector graphics.
method: Points at +eta and -eta are pooled into bins of 0.1 in |eta|. Smearing for d0 at all |eta| and dz below |eta| 2.5 is calculated in the following way: sigma(pT) = (a^k + (b / pT)^k)^(1/k), with a and b fitted per |eta| bin, and with one k per axis and region (|eta| below or above 2.5), each point weighted by its error bar. Smearing for dz above |eta| 2.5 is approximated using straight lines in log sigma against log pT through the three values per bin. Each table entry is that width at the bin's geometric pT centre and |eta| centre. Below 1 GeV and above 100 GeV the widths are extrapolations: the formula continued (approaching b / pT at low and a at high pT), and for dz beyond |eta| 2.5 slope -1 below 1 GeV and constant above 100 GeV.
binning: pt_lower_edges: lower edge of each pT bin; the first bin also holds all lower pT, the last all higher pT. abs_eta_upper_edges: upper edge of each |eta| bin except the last, which holds all higher |eta|. A value equal to an edge belongs to the lower bin. Widths: one row per |eta| bin, one column per pT bin.
